      Problem: The heredoc used to list `template_path` is indented with tabs, but it is not using the `<<-` operator.; Standard heredocs (`<<`) preserve leading whitespace. The subsequent `copy_from_ref_or_local` call will attempt to fetch these non-existent files and fail. While the loop has an `|| true` guard, it means none of the required templates will actually be fetched, causing Phase 2 to fail because the harness is incomplete.
